g.text: Runtime events to product UI projection
Display raw delta text as it arrives.
Replace it with completed persistent content.
No thinking event means no frame.
Render Markdown through the same allowlist.
Label the disclosure as raw reasoning.
Current and failed tools remain expanded.
Successful tool details collapse by default.
Arguments are row, depth, and length bounded.
Credentials and internal IDs are redacted.
Absolute paths are reduced to the last segment.
Result text uses the safe Markdown renderer.
Use a User turn as the product round boundary.
Join non-empty Assistant rawMarkdown in order.
Exclude thinking and tool diagnostics from copy.
Hide the copy icon while the round is active.
Network loss does not replay the POST.
Keep the submitted draft until user.message
or persistent history confirms a new Entry.
If confirmation is still missing, mark the
outcome uncertain and forbid blind retry.
Adjust direction does not interrupt the
current model call or tool execution.
append delta then replace with completed
